question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing ‘4’. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2baac5b3ff5fa3e7c450a0cb8a0b2cb47b4e0d24034f76aacdf4139c556dc2e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7965f396fa19fd867852debaa60745dc854a92e8eaeb6e7af04e4ce273d1ffa6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1f8777d374452c05305bd17bf96139de95cf1fa31e03ff319feb8b08969b36.png]
solution:
In figure 1 and 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2baac5b3ff5fa3e7c450a0cb8a0b2cb47b4e0d24034f76aacdf4139c556dc2e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1f8777d374452c05305bd17bf96139de95cf1fa31e03ff319feb8b08969b36.png] 

→ Face 1 and Face 5 are common ⇒ **Face 2 is opposite to Face 4.**
